description: Stochastically routes two inputs to two outputs, a virtual coin toss at each trigger deciding whether they swap

params.text: Sets the chance of the routing operation, 0% fully anticlockwise and 100% fully clockwise, with 50% at noon
Adds 10V to the TRIG input, which fires a coin toss whenever that crosses the rise threshold
Picks what a positive coin toss does: TOG flips the current routing, SWAP sets the swapped routing, GATE holds a swap while TRIG is low and allows no-swap for the length of a high TRIG
Sets the voltage the trigger must rise to before it counts as high, -10V to 10V, 1V by default
Sets the voltage the trigger must fall below before it counts as low again, -10V to 10V, 0.1V by default
Adds an offset of -10V to 10V to that input, applied after its SCALE knob
Attenuates or inverts that input, -1 to 1, before its OFFSET knob is added
Picks what the A input is normalled to: red passes the raw trigger input, blue passes the Schmitt trigger gate, 0V low and 10V high

inputs.text: One of the two signals the coin toss routes; unpatched it takes the TRIG input
The other signal the coin toss routes; unpatched it is 0V
A rise past the RISE threshold fires a coin toss; the input counts as low again once it drops below the FALL threshold
Modulates the probability, each volt adding 10% of chance to the PROB knob

outputs.text: Carries the A input while the routing is unswapped and the B input while it is swapped
Carries the B input while the routing is unswapped and the A input while it is swapped

notes: setting RISE below FALL reverses the trigger, so the coin toss happens on the falling edge instead
menu: Polyphony control — Trig and Prob only counts channels from those two inputs, the default; All inputs counts all four, which lets A and B channels scramble across the two outputs
Audio process — Off, Antipop crossfade for slow switching, or oversample x2, x4, x8 or x16 for switching at audio rates; leave it Off for gates and CV
Monitor channel — which polyphonic channel the two routing lights report, 1 to 16, or Off
Add Bernoulli Switch expander — places one immediately to the right, giving a CV input for every parameter
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
Preset — four factory presets set the module up as a coin-tossed gate: Bernoulli Gate, Toggled Bernoulli Gate, Latched Bernoulli Gate and Latched Toggled Bernoulli Gate
